principles: Strictly in-module + read-only; reuse summary.ts; preserve zero cross-module imports
Reporter is a runnable task, NOT a registered CLI command (no command-registry/other-logic changes)
Cost only from an injected price table — never hardcode prices
unknown/unavailable stays unknown (never 0); estimates never counted as final; feeds no gate
drivers: User explicitly required modularity and no changes to other logic code
Operators need to read per-story/per-model usage (and optional cost) from a ledger file
Diagnostics must stay read-only so it can never become a blocking mechanism

options.name: A: diagnostics.ts + a runnable reporter task (npm script)
cons: Reporter is a task over a file path, not a first-class lattice command

options.name: B: register a lattice usage CLI command
cons: Touches the command registry / cli-engine (other logic) — violates the user's constraint — rejected

chosen: A: diagnostics.ts + a runnable reporter task (npm script)
rationale: Option A keeps every change inside the usage-ledger module + its task + package.json, honoring the user's explicit 'don't modify other logic code' constraint and preserving the module's zero cross-module imports, while still delivering real read-only diagnostics (grouped usage + optional injected-price cost) over any ledger file.

preMortem.scenario: Reporter gets registered as a CLI command / touches the command registry
preMortem.mitigation: Reporter is a task only; verifier asserts the diff never touches cli-engine/handlers/command-registry; execution boundary excludes them

preMortem.scenario: Hardcoded prices couple the module to a billing source
preMortem.mitigation: Cost only from an injected price table; verifier greps for hardcoded dollar amounts/price constants (must be none); cost null when no table
Reuse summary.ts unknown handling; smoke asserts unknown stays unknown (never 0) across groups

preMortem.consequence: Diagnostics turns into a blocking mechanism
preMortem.mitigation: No gate/verdict/decision/blocker field; not imported by any handler/gate; smoke asserts
Static zero-cross-module-import assert in the smoke + verifier; diagnostics.ts imports only sibling files + node builtins
